name: BEAR*
desc:
Join the BEAR* Group to redeem Daily Rewards!

Bear is a vicious, all devouring entity that overran the world faster than anyone could've anticipated. Bear only needs to get lucky once, while you must get lucky every single time.

CONTROLS
Sprinting - (Keyboard - Shift) (Controller - B)
Flashlight - (Keyboard - F) (Controller - X)
Crouching - (Keyboard - C) (Controller - Left Thumbstick Tap)
